recentItems.description:
For more information, or to purchase, go to https://www.alfred.com/products/the-ocean-rolls-beneath-the-sky-00-52839

The Ocean Rolls Beneath the Sky

Words and music by Mary Donnelly and George L. O. Strid
Item: 00-52839
Voicing: 2-Part
Alfred Choral Designs
Available: 2-Part
This treble treasure turns the tide's push and pull into a song about weathering whatever comes. Two vocal parts move together in uncomplicated harmony, a friendly setup for singers of any age. Storms, tides, and a moonlit shore all get their turn in the lyric before it lands on its reassuring theme: "Every wave we learn to ride will carry us along." An optional flute part (free to download) adds an airy accent.

recentItems.title: Stars to Hold (SATB) by Victor C. Johnson
recentItems.description:
For more information, or to purchase, go to https://www.alfred.com/products/stars-to-hold-00-52843

Stars to Hold

Words by Sara Teasdale, music by Victor C. Johnson
Item: 00-52843
Voicing: SATB
Alfred Choral Designs
Available: SATB, SAB, SSA
Victor C. Johnson turns Sara Teasdale's sea-and-starlight imagery into a stunning emotional arc with this original concert work. The sensitive setting traces peace flowing in like the tide, grows richer and as the full-voiced choir builds to its artistic high point, then settles back into the quiet plea that opened the piece. A shimmering piano part and an optional cello obbligato add warmth throughout. "Give me your stars to hold."

recentItems.title: I Can Sing! (SATB) by Greg Gilpin
recentItems.description:
For more information, or to purchase, go to https://www.alfred.com/products/i-can-sing-00-52809

I Can Sing!

Words by James Weldon Johnson, music and additional words by Greg Gilpin
Item: 00-52809
Voicing: SATB
Alfred Choral Designs
Available: SATB, 3-Part Mixed, SSA
Greg Gilpin captures the uplifting message in James Weldon Johnson's poem: music can carry us through dark nights, long days, life's challenges. Opening with hushed, layered entrances, the piece steadily gathers strength as lightly syncopated phrases pass around the ensemble. The "music is all around me" refrain declares that music itself is where we belong. A joyful reminder of why we sing in the first place.

recentItems.description:
For more information, or to purchase, go to https://www.alfred.com/products/Coming-of-the-Rain-00-52480

Coming of the Rain

Words and music by Wayne Dauer
Item: 00-52480
Voicing: 2-Part
Alfred Choral Designs
Available: 2-Part
Rain and wind appear as two separate melodies in this original nature-inspired choral. Part I sings about coming rain; Part II joins with its own tune about swirling winds and falling leaves on the repeat. All throughout, independent voice parts create a textured rainstorm soundscape. Optional classroom percussion is designed for student players. A delightful teaching piece, filled with practical pedagogy and artful elements.

recentItems.title: Sutoku In (SATB) by Ruth Morris Gray
recentItems.description:
For more information, or to purchase, go to https://www.alfred.com/products/sutoku-in-00-52479

Sutoku In

Words by Emperor Sutoku, music by Ruth Morris Gray
Item: 00-52479
Voicing: SATB
Alfred Choral Designs
Available: SATB, 3-Part Mixed, 2-Part
The text of this multicultural feature is a waka (an ancient Japanese poetic form) written by 12th-century ruler Emperor Sutoku. Ruth Morris Gray's original music highlights the poem's depth and explores its theme of separation. Crafted with two minor-key melodies (one sung in Japanese, the other in English) that artfully intertwine at the pinnacle moment. A pronunciation guide is included in the publication.

Easy to learn, with well-crafted minor-key harmonies that surprise with a Picardy third at the end.
